description: Source code for NdkCaptureRequest, part of Android camera hardware interface, defining functions for creating, modifying, and managing capture requests and output targets.

methods.name: ACameraOutputTarget_create
methods.description: Creates a new ACameraOutputTarget object with the specified window.

methods.name: ACameraOutputTarget_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for an ACameraOutputTarget object.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_addTarget
methods.description: Adds an output target to the capture request.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_removeTarget
methods.description: Removes an output target from the capture request.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_getConstEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a constant metadata entry from the request.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_getConstEntry_physicalCamera
methods.description: Retrieves a constant metadata entry for a specific physical camera.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_getAllTags
methods.description: Gets all metadata tags associated with the request.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_u8
methods.description: Sets a uint8_t entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_i32
methods.description: Sets an int32_t entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_float
methods.description: Sets a float entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_double
methods.description: Sets a double entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_i64
methods.description: Sets an int64_t entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_rational
methods.description: Sets a rational entry in the request's settings.

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_physicalCamera_u8

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_physicalCamera_i32

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_physicalCamera_float

methods.name: ACaptureRequest_setEntry_physicalCamera_double

methods.description: Associates a user-defined context with the request.
